notes:
# BondoMod 0.2.6

- Limited cosmetic packet processing to prevent repeated long forwarding delays. When processing exceeds its time budget, original game packets continue through the existing connection.
- Moved network diagnostic logging into a bounded background queue.
- Limited retained match encryption contexts and prioritized the newest context.
- The uninstaller now carries its own network recovery helper and dependencies, instead of relying on files in the installed app folder.
- Network cleanup is still verified before uninstall completes.
- Fixed enabling Item Spawn with a legacy shortcut that conflicts with the main menu. Switch messages now appear directly below the switch.
- Titles remain in development.
- Added voluntary diagnostic reports in Settings, with a full preview, explicit consent and deletion controls. Reports can be viewed in the protected website Admin Place.
